item.title: Version 1.0.22
item.description:
What's new

  • Two new pets, each in its own app: Lavi, who sits on top of your window and swings her legs, and Bricky, a little brick knight who lays a brick for every task you finish.
  • Pets of every kind can be friends: Lavi and Bricky show up properly in your sessions and on the friends list.
  • Under-the-hood cleanup of the app files.
